title: NexSolve Exposure & Vulnerability Intelligence Dataset Inventory
spatial_reference: Official Survey of India (SoI) Administrative Boundaries (8 NER States, 131 Districts)
governance: P6 Pipeline Locked; No Model Training; No Synthetic Numbers

datasets.name: Census of India 2011 Primary Census Abstract (PCA)
datasets.provider: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI), Ministry of Home Affairs, GoI
datasets.district_coverage: 131/131 Districts (Mapped to current SoI LGD boundaries)
datasets.limitations: Reference year is 2011; population counts require decade growth projections for current 2026 estimations.
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE for district-level baseline demographic vulnerability and population count
datasets.classification_reason: 100% Official GoI authoritative source, classified B solely due to 2011 temporal age requiring growth projection caveats.

datasets.name: WorldPop Gridded Population Count (Constrained 100m)
datasets.provider: WorldPop Project, University of Southampton / CIESIN
datasets.download_method: HTTP Direct Download / WorldPop Data Portal
datasets.limitations: Statistical disaggregation model derived from building footprints and satellite covariates.
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE for spatial hazard-population overlay disaggregation
datasets.classification_reason: High-resolution 100m spatial distribution grid, UN-aligned methodology, usable with spatial disaggregation caveats.

datasets.name: LandScan Global Ambient Population Distribution
datasets.provider: Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) / US Dept of Energy
datasets.limitations: Licensing restrictions prohibit inclusion in open SIH prototype codebases.
datasets.classification_reason: REJECT due to redistribution license restrictions.

datasets.name: ISRO Bhuvan Land Use Land Cover (1:50,000 & Built-Up Surface)
datasets.licensing: Government of India ISRO Data Policy (Free for Indian R&D and non-commercial prototypes)
datasets.limitations: WMS tile viewing is seamless; vector extraction requires NRSC geoportal authorization.
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE for built-up settlement footprint mapping in landslide hazard zones
datasets.classification_reason: Official ISRO/NRSC government satellite asset; highly suitable for production-like prototype decision support.

datasets.name: Global Human Settlement Layer Built-up Surface (GHS-BUILT-S)
datasets.limitations: Satellite optical sensor cloud cover in NER monsoon months can affect building detection accuracy.
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE for cross-validating satellite-derived built-up density
datasets.classification_reason: Open international research dataset usable with cloud-cover validation caveats.

datasets.name: MoRTH / NHAI National Highway Network Registry
datasets.provider: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) / NHAI / GIS Cell
datasets.state_coverage: 8/8 NER States (NH-2, NH-6, NH-10, NH-306, NH-44, NH-37, etc.)
datasets.district_coverage: Corridor alignments traversing all 8 NER states
datasets.limitations: Covers arterial National Highways; state highways and border roads require state PWD/BRO supplemental layers.
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE for highway hazard exposure and corridor vulnerability assessment
datasets.classification_reason: Official MoRTH/NHAI government registry; production-like decision support standard.

datasets.name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) Rural Road Database
datasets.provider: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) / NRRDA / C-DAC
datasets.spatial_resolution: District / Block rural road network lines
datasets.limitations: Attribute completeness varies across remote hilly blocks in Arunachal Pradesh and Nagaland.
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE for rural community isolation risk evaluation
datasets.classification_reason: Official MoRD rural road dataset usable with attribute completeness caveats in remote hilly blocks.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap (OSM) Road Network Overlay
datasets.limitations: Community mapped; MUST NOT replace official Survey of India administrative boundaries or official highway routes.
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE FOR CONTEXTUAL VISUALIZATION ONLY (Explicitly labeled as OSM)
datasets.classification_reason: Open community dataset suitable for supplementary visualization; cannot be claimed as government-authoritative.

datasets.name: MoHFW / NHA Health Facility Registry (HFR)
datasets.provider: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) / National Health Authority
datasets.limitations: Some remote primary health sub-centers in hill districts lack exact GPS coordinates.
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE for medical emergency accessibility and hospital exposure analysis
datasets.classification_reason: Official GoI healthcare registry; production-grade decision support standard.

datasets.name: UDISE+ School & Shelter Infrastructure Registry
datasets.provider: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education, GoI
datasets.limitations: Point coordinates for private schools in rural blocks require verification.
datasets.authoritative_tier: Government of India (Official Ministry of Education)
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE for school population exposure and potential relief shelter identification
datasets.classification_reason: Official Ministry of Education dataset; production-grade decision support standard.

datasets.name: NITI Aayog National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)
datasets.crs: Non-spatial / Joins directly to SoI District LGD Code
datasets.licensing: Open Government Data (Public Domain / Government Report)
datasets.limitations: District indices reflect sample survey periods (NFHS-5: 2019-2021).
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE for computing composite socio-economic vulnerability scores
datasets.classification_reason: Official NITI Aayog socio-economic index; ideal for district-level vulnerability scaling.

datasets.name: BMTPC Vulnerability Atlas of India (Housing & Multi-Hazard)
datasets.provider: Building Materials & Technology Promotion Council (BMTPC), MoHUA, GoI
datasets.licensing: Government of India BMTPC Policy (Free for disaster management)
datasets.limitations: Housing construction types are aggregated at district level.
datasets.decision_support_verdict: SAFE for housing structural vulnerability assessment
datasets.classification_reason: Official GoI structural vulnerability baseline; production-grade standard.
